8f16f9de31.q: What is Juice Con and why was it created?
8f16f9de31.a: Juice Con is the only conference in the entire world for juicing professionals where people that run juice bars, juice trucks, grocery stores that sell juice, restaurants, or wholesale juice businesses can come together and share information to help each other grow. It was started because every single juice bar that opened had the same struggles, and the founder started a blog in 2014 to help people save themselves from these problems before going through them themselves.

2adbec4082.q: What is the format of Juice Con and how are sessions structured?
2adbec4082.a: Juice Con is formatted like TED Talks for Juice where knowledgeable speakers from all over the world give 15 to 20-minute presentations followed by panel discussions with other juice business owners. The audience can ask questions directly, chat with speakers after presentations, and there are vendor booths with workshops in a side room. There is also a live functioning juice bar at the event.

c6078f4ab5.q: What is the World Juicing Championship at Juice Con and how does it work?
c6078f4ab5.a: The World Juicing Championship takes place at the end of the second day of Juice Con and focuses on green juice. Participants submit their best green juice recipe to Ari, ingredients are provided on site, and participants make the juice with Ari in the morning. The audience tastes all juices and votes, while a panel of expert judges including Kwai Chang (who won the first World Juicing Championship) and Ari select the winner who receives the supreme title of world best green juice.

b07c6f0282.q: How does Wild Honey's branding incorporate local Wisconsin elements like honey and organic produce?
b07c6f0282.a: The branding was developed around a core affection for honeybees and jewel-toned earthy colors including forest green and gold. The brand guide features an illustrated honeybee and honeycomb designed by illustrator Celia. The color palette reflects both the juice colors—like the deep red of beets and deep greens of vegetables—and local Wisconsin heritage, with gold representing honey and carrots and other earth-provided ingredients from the surrounding Driftless area.

8463e14e93.q: What in-house production capabilities does Wild Honey operate beyond juices and smoothies?

461ce9a575.q: Why is Koji milk significant for Wild Honey and what makes it notable in Wisconsin?
461ce9a575.a: Wild Honey is the first retailer in Wisconsin to stock Koji milk, a premium oat milk made from fermented Japanese rice with no gums or additives. They went through one full pallet in two months and had to order a second pallet due to customer demand. The milk is used in lattes and smoothies and is priced at a premium but valued for its clean formulation.
